name: aivantage-dev
description: Root-level dev orchestrator - runs frontend, backend, and AI engine together with one command. Not part of any individual service's own package.json.

scripts.dev:mac: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND,AI-ENGINE -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix frontend/frontend run dev" "cd backend && /usr/local/apache-maven/bin/mvn spring-boot:run" "cd ai-engine && venv/bin/python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000"
scripts.dev:win: concurrently -n FRONTEND,BACKEND,AI-ENGINE -c blue,green,magenta "npm --prefix frontend/frontend run dev" "cd backend && mvn spring-boot:run" "cd ai-engine && venv\Scripts\python -m uvicorn main:app --reload --port 8000"
